title: Modelling, Simulation & Testing Intern
description: Role & responsibilities 1. Analytical Modelling & Simulation Develop mathematical and numerical models for parachute inflation, deployment, and descent dynamics. Build simulation tools using MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or equivalent platforms. Analyse aerodynamic drag, opening forces, inflation time, trajectory, and altitude loss. Conduct sensitivity and parametric studies under different operating conditions. Maintain documented and reusable simulation scripts. 2. Experimental Testing & Data Acquisition Assist in planning and conducting drag, deployment, drop, and component-level tests. Prepare test procedures, test matrices, and instrumentation requirements. Support setup and calibration of load cells, sensors, anemometers, cameras, and data acquisition systems. Collect and organize test data and configuration records. Participate in factory and external testing, following approved safety procedures. 3. Data Analysis & Model Validation Process test data to calculate drag coefficients, opening loads, and inflation characteristics. Apply signal filtering, data synchronization, and statistical analysis. Compare test results with simulation predictions and investigate discrepancies. Identify model limitations, measurement uncertainties, and experimental errors. Refine models using validated test data and prepare tech Preferred candidate profile Basic knowledge of mathematical modelling, numerical methods, and simulation. Working knowledge of MATLAB, Simulink, Python, or equivalent platforms. Basic understanding of instrumentation and measurement systems, including sensors, load cells, actuators, data acquisition systems (DAQ), and testing equipment. Familiarity with sensor calibration, signal acquisition, and interpretation of experimental data would be an advantage. Interest in hands-on experimental testing, equipment setup, troubleshooting, and validation activities. Willingness to travel to manufacturing and external testing facilities as required. Strong analytical, documentation, and problem-solving skills
